title_en: Cake pricing starts with your working hours
description_en: Have you counted the work around the cake as well as decorating? Review sourcing, baking, cleaning and order admin. Enter your own time and chosen pay in the free price check. Get the result by email.

title_en: A cake box belongs in the quote too
description_en: Boards, boxes and packaging can be easy to miss when reusing an old quote. Check the inputs behind your next price with the free calculator. Email result available; complete Excel workbook sold separately.

title_en: What does your payment fee do to the cake price?
description_en: A percentage fee changes with the selling price. Add your real provider fees to your costs before choosing a margin. Try the free cake price check and receive your calculation by email.

title_en: How much does the recipe actually cost?
description_en: Use the cost of the amount in the recipe, not the whole pack price. Example: $4 per 1,000 g means 250 g costs $1. Check your full cake costs in the free calculator. Illustrative figures; result by email.
visual_brief_cz: Hotová grafika PNG a editovatelná sazba SVG.
alt_text_en: Recipe cost example: a $4 pack of 1,000 grams means using 250 grams costs $1.

title_en: Is the cake price covering your chosen pay?
description_en: A quote may cover ingredients while leaving too little for the hours you entered. Check ingredients, time, overheads and fees together. The free calculator sends the requested result by email.

title_en: Cleaning time is still working time
description_en: Before the next custom cake quote, review the tasks that belong to that order. Include the hours you expect to work and the pay you choose. Try one free cake price check; result by email.
